verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the solution page, which positions Document AI for compliance-first organizations needing secure on-premises deployment and points to a public Trust Center. Self-hosting would keep documents off Mistral's infrastructure, which indirectly prevents their use in training. However, nothing in the pack explicitly addresses training on customer data. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training or opt-out policy for API data, documentation of the opt-out control or default behavior, data retention terms, and independent corroboration.
